name: N-phenethyl-14-ethoxymetopon
summary: N-Phenethyl-14-ethoxymetopon is a drug that is a derivative of metopon. It is a potent analgesic, around 60 times stronger than morphine and produces significantly less constipation.

pharmacology.text: N-Phenethyl-14-ethoxymetopon acts as an agonist at both μ- and δ-opioid receptors, with a Ki of 0.16 nM at μ and 3.14 nM at δ.

uses.en: It is a research compound and has never been approved as a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，從未被核准作為藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，从未被核准作为药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether. As a very potent opioid, it would carry a high risk of overdose and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。作為藥效極強的鴉片類藥物，它的過量與成癮風險都很高。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。作为药效极强的鸦片类药物，它的过量与成瘾风险都很高。

fact.en: Swapping the small methyl group on the nitrogen of a morphine-type drug for a larger phenethyl group often makes it much stronger, and this compound is one example of that trick.
fact.zh: 把嗎啡類藥物氮原子上的小甲基換成較大的苯乙基，往往會讓藥效大幅增強，這個化合物就是一例。
fact.zhHans: 把吗啡类药物氮原子上的小甲基换成较大的苯乙基，往往会让药效大幅增强，这个化合物就是一例。
